description: This file defines a custom lint detector for Android projects that checks for the usage of Compose Material APIs instead of the designated equivalents from the Now in Android design system module. It reports issues when such usages are detected.

classes.name: DesignSystemDetector
classes.description: A custom lint detector class that checks for incorrect usages of Compose Material APIs over the designated design system APIs.

methods.name: getApplicableUastTypes
methods.description: Returns the list of UAST node types (call expressions and qualified references) that this detector is interested in.

methods.name: createUastHandler
methods.description: Creates and returns a UElementHandler that processes relevant UAST nodes to identify and report issues.

methods.name: visitCallExpression
methods.description: Handles UCallExpression nodes; checks method names against a map of preferred names and reports issues if applicable.

methods.name: visitQualifiedReferenceExpression
methods.description: Handles UQualifiedReferenceExpression nodes; checks receiver names against a map of preferred names and reports issues if applicable.

methods.name: reportIssue
methods.description: Reports a detected usage issue, indicating the use of a non-preferred API in the code.
